changes: Starting a search clears the previous result, selection, cover title and clip state; moment actions are disabled while searching.
Clip titles use the completed result query rather than an unsubmitted editable draft.
Recording responses from a prior session cannot replace the newly selected session.
Clip status updates require the same current pending clip ID.
Live AI sample mode explicitly discloses API charges; offline mode remains free.
